organizations.publicNote: German recording company active from 1925 to 1972; the linked discs use Electrola as their imprint. In 1972 Electrola-Gesellschaft and Carl Lindström GmbH were merged into the successor company EMI Electrola. The designation E.G. belongs to a record series, not to the organization’s name.

sources.shortCitation: His Master’s Voice E.G. 2481, “’S wird schon wieder besser” (Dolly Haas, 1932)
sources.fullCitation: Dolly Haas with a chamber orchestra directed by Hans Sommer. “’S wird schon wieder besser.” YouTube transfer published by Marconiphone; the upload identifies His Master’s Voice E.G. 2481, gives the additional number 60-1853, credits the music to Jurmann and Kaper, associates the song with Liebe mit Bewährungsfrist and dates the recording to Berlin, 1932.
sources.title: ’S wird schon wieder besser — His Master’s Voice E.G. 2481
sources.creator: Dolly Haas; Kammerorchester, Hans Sommer, director
sources.researchNote: The disc identification, additional number 60-1853, performers, film association, music credits and recording year are supplied by the upload description; the disc label is not shown. The description lists 60-1853 without identifying its function. That number is retained without an independently established matrix or take identification. No independent label or session record has been matched to this transfer. The source retains the uploader’s specific disc identification as reported, not verified, and 1932 is not treated as an established issue date.

media.description: Listening reference for “Es wird schon wieder besser”, attributed by the uploader to Dolly Haas with a chamber orchestra under Hans Sommer. The description gives His Master’s Voice E.G. 2481, the additional number 60-1853 and a Berlin recording in 1932. The disc is not shown, and neither the pressing nor the number’s function as a matrix has been independently verified.
